title: The Great Full Moon Recharge
skyStory: One hundred percent. Every last inch of the moon is lit, and it has skipped into Gemini, the sign of the twins, which is frankly perfect for two people carrying each other's stones. Gemini loves a pair. Tonight it shines on the ruby and the onyx like a spotlight on a duet. Mars and Saturn have stopped bickering to watch. Even the gale holds its breath.

reading: Tonight is the Full Moon Recharge. Set the onyx bracelet on the windowsill where the moonlight lands, and leave it there while you do something slow by the fire. You will feel oddly light without it on your wrist, which is the point. Things that carry us need resting too.

While it charges, think about the [[Six of Pentacles]]: the giving hand and the receiving hand. Tonight the moon is the giver and you are only the one who holds still. Practise that. Let the light pour on something you love without doing anything about it. At bedtime, put the bracelet back on your left wrist, the receiving side, and feel it hum.
joel.mission: Charge the onyx under the moon for at least an hour, and do not check on it more than twice.
joel.omen: Moonlight making a bright square on the floor. That is your landing pad; stand in it for one breath.

reading: The ruby goes on the sill tonight, side by side with Joel's onyx in spirit, and probably in a photo too. Gemini doubles everything, so expect the moonlight to feel like it is shining on two windowsills at once, one by the cabin and one by the shore.

Bring all five stones if you like, a full council of elements lined up under the light: earth, fire, water, wind and heart, reporting for duty. Tell them the best story you have this month while they charge. They are an excellent audience. Then put the ruby back on your right pinky and admire it. It will look brighter. [[The Sun]] asks you to allow joy, and tonight it is shining right on your hand.
nancy.mission: Line up all five stones on the windowsill in element order and take one photo for Joel.
nancy.omen: A bright star sitting right beside the moon. Someone far away is shining back at you.

together.text: Recharge together at the agreed minute. Send one photo each of your stones in the moonlight, then switch: Joel moves the onyx to his right wrist for a minute to send strength, Nancy turns the ruby toward the window. Fire and Mountain, fully charged.
